environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate, but fronted by AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validator attached to the PATCH /api/v1/profile route. The route uses an OpenAPI 3.0 schema model (content-type application/json) that defines the request body with 'additionalProperties: false' and only permits the properties 'username' (string, maxLength 64) and 'email' (string, format email, maxLength 128). The API Gateway request validator is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true'. Requests containing any JSON property not in the schema (such as 'role', 'is_admin', 'quota_gb', 'billing_id', 'verified') receive a 400 response from the gateway before reaching the backend. Note: the validator operates on the parsed JSON body and rejects payloads with undeclared keys due to the additionalProperties constraint. The integration uses VPC Link to the internal ALB which forwards to the ECS service.

config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway HTTP API with OpenAPI 3.0 model validation
config.validator_behavior: Returns 400 Bad Request for any payload with properties not defined in schema
config.integration: VPC Link to internal ALB -> ECS target group
config.auth: API Gateway JWT authorizer + sidecar sets X-Authenticated-User-ID
